source_note: Rail North America KPIs from GATX quarterly earnings releases (Q4 2025, Q1 2026, Q2 2026 tables). Consensus from FactSet. Bond yield from the 2035 notes.

kpis.name: Renewal pricing (Lease Price Index)
kpis.plain: How much more GATX charges on renewal than the expiring lease.
kpis.thesis_read: Slowing. Guide is high teens to low 20s for 2026.

kpis.name: Renewal success rate
kpis.plain: Share of expiring cars the same customer renews.
kpis.line_label: Watch: a third print below 85% is a trend
kpis.thesis_read: Two of the last three quarters below 85%.

kpis.name: Average renewal term
kpis.plain: How long customers sign for. Shorter terms mean less confidence.
kpis.thesis_read: Down from 61 to 54 months since Q1 2025, three straight declines.

kpis.name: Fleet utilization
kpis.thesis_read: Still full. The Wells Fargo cars pulled the combined number to 98%.

other.name: Legacy disposition gains, 2026
other.value: about $94M of legacy booked in H1 vs $130M guide (Rail NA segment total $117.5M includes GABX)
other.line: Kill criterion: full-year legacy below the $130M guide; model carries $140M (v39)

other.name: Credit rating
other.value: S&P BBB, Moody's Baa1 stable (upgraded 6/30/26), Fitch BBB+
other.line: Below BBB- fires the kill criterion

bmg.model: GATX-FSM-v40 (Valuation Section C1 bear/bull EPS snapshots refreshed to post-v39 engine; disposition gains basis corrected 2026-10-09; prior v32 $165.54 held through v38); price $162.78 at 2026-10-08 close, FactSet SIP consolidated (Cowork verified)
bmg.ntm_dividend_basis: $0.66 declared quarterly x 4; model 2027E DPS = $2.74 as a footnote
